comment: Love this guy. He keeps it real. I do think he underestimates students, though, making the class pretty easy, but still very enjoyable. Class usually ends around 8:30, not 10. Only had 2(3?) quizzes including the final throughout and they're all online

This is easily the nicest professor I've had at Richmond. His lectures were striaghtforward and easy to understand. The downside is class was monday nights from 6:30-9:50pm, but we never stayed later than 8:30. He gives weekly SQL quizzes and homeworks, but they're all so fair. Very little homework and fun lectures equals a great course
